name: conversekit
description: Multi-tenant conversational AI platform – Cloudflare Workers + Hono + Supabase + pluggable AI vendors

scripts.build: npm run build:app && npm run build:assets
scripts.dev:site: node scripts/build-assets.mjs site && node scripts/dev-static.mjs apps/site/dist --port 8788
scripts.dev:cdn: node scripts/build-assets.mjs cdn && node scripts/dev-static.mjs apps/cdn/dist --port 8789
scripts.deploy:app: npm run build:app && npm run deploy -w conversekit-app
scripts.deploy:cdn: node scripts/build-assets.mjs cdn && npm run deploy -w conversekit-cdn
scripts.deploy:site: node scripts/build-assets.mjs site && npm run deploy -w conversekit-site
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:api && npm run deploy:app && npm run deploy:cdn && npm run deploy:site
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check -w conversekit-api && npm run type-check -w conversekit-app
scripts.test: npm run test:widget && npm run test:widget-theme && npm run test:session-units && npm run test:rag && npm run test:stats && npm run test:config && npm run test:leads && npm run test:knowledge && npm run test:profile && npm run test:entitlements
scripts.check:landing: node scripts/build-assets.mjs site && node scripts/gen-vendor-sprite.mjs --check && node scripts/gen-shots.mjs --check && node scripts/check-landing.mjs
